title: Anatidaephobia
description: Somewhere nearby… a duck is watching you.
body:
Anatidaephobia is a joke mod based on the fictitious fear that a duck might be watching you. Ducks will stalk players from a distance. Sometimes their arrival is announced by a quack or a message. There are three normal color variants and a very rare sunglasses duck. Ducks will flee when approached, but they can also be tamed using bread. Once tamed, they follow the player, and grant Dolphin’s Grace while swimming nearby. Ducks may also drop duck meat for cooking and eating.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why are Mobs not spawning?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where do Ducks spawn?

Ducks can spawn anywhere in the overworld near a player.

</details>





![info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2c158488f083d7a57043de02f4dc2696c484740.png)
The Duck is a passive mob that can randomly spawn near players. There are three standard color variants, plus a very rare sunglasses variant. When a duck spawns, there is a chance to hear a duck sound or receive the actionbar message “I think something is watching me…”. Ducks will always stalk the nearest player. Ducks have low health and do not attack. If a player comes within 10 blocks, untamed ducks will panic and run away. Players can right-click ducks with bread to tame them. Tamed ducks will follow their owner unless right-clicked again, can be healed using bread, and while swimming near their owner, they grant Dolphin’s Grace to help with underwater movement. When killed, ducks can drop duck meat, which can be eaten raw or cooked for better food value. 

 

- Config File not inculed.
